note: Horses and farm animals (docs/animal/PLAN.md §3). The main view is the side profile (D-14). A horse's knee (carpus) bends forward, its hock backward; every desc says where each of the four legs is because gaits are read by leg pairs. No saddle, bridle, halter, harness, rider, cart, bell, ear tag or rope; no slaughter or injury.
